summary: Kura Oncology disclosed in an Item 8.01 8-K that it formed Caspian Therapeutics, a wholly owned subsidiary, to develop next-generation menin inhibitors (including KO-7246) for diabetes and cardiometabolic disease. On September 8, 2026, Caspian sold $50.0 million of Series A preferred stock in a private financing; Kura invested $4.3 million. Post-financing, Kura holds approximately 49.2% of Caspian's outstanding capital stock, with a Contribution and License Agreement assigning assets for common shares plus up to $1.5 million reimbursement. The structure is a partial monetization/carve-out; watch milestone disclosures and potential further Caspian financings, which could dilute Kura below control and reframe value.
